object.attr: derived: CF-S40. A cloned repository can hold symbolic links (checked out as links on Linux and macOS, and on Windows with core.symlinks), and writing or deleting through one changes a file outside the repository. Folders above the root don't count, so a root reached through a link still works. Decided on 2026-11-10.
object.description: If a file Mellon is about to write or delete, or a folder between the repository root and the file, is a symbolic link or junction, Mellon shall refuse the operation.
